findings.body: For every concrete `neq` filter, this emits `NOT (expression = ANY(...))`. When the selected dimension is missing, `expression` is SQL NULL, so the predicate evaluates to NULL rather than TRUE and the row is discarded. For example, `nursery_component != <component>` drops a known-Plant Unmapped actual, and `gl != <code>` drops an actual with a missing GL. This violates the required retention of known-Plant Unmapped/missing dimensions and makes summary/detail totals incomplete.
findings.title: Not done: retain missing dimensions under negative filters

findings.body: The required database proof exercises only `eq` filters for component, GL, and section. It never exercises `neq`, `in`, missing/Unmapped values, or the remaining supported dimensions, so defects in those branches—including the NULL-dropping `neq` behavior—do not fail the named test. Add independent expected-row assertions covering every operator and supported dimension, including nullable dimension rows.
findings.title: Not done: predicate tests cover all filter semantics
